description: This file defines the class AboveKeyPositionCalculator, which implements the PositionCalculator interface. It calculates the position for a preview popup in a custom keyboard, based on key position, theme, and window offset.

classes.name: AboveKeyPositionCalculator
classes.description: A class responsible for calculating the position of a preview popup above a keyboard key, considering theme and animation style.

methods.name: calculatePositionForPreview
methods.description: Calculates the position (Point) for displaying a preview popup based on the key, theme, and window offset.
